subject: general
question: Which of the following Fundamental Rights is included in Article 16 of the Indian Constitution?

options.text: Equality of opportunity in public employment

solution:
The correct answer is __**Equality of opportunity in public employment**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Equality of opportunity in public employment** is enshrined in Article 16 of the Indian Constitution.
 
• Article 16 ensures that there shall be equality of opportunity for all citizens in matters relating to employment or appointment to any office under the State.
 
• It prohibits discrimination on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex, descent, place of birth, residence, or any of them in respect of any employment or office under the State.
 
• The aim of Article 16 is to provide a level playing field for all citizens and to ensure that public employment is accessible to all without any form of discrimination.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 16** is part of the Fundamental Rights enshrined in Part III of the Indian Constitution.
 
• Fundamental Rights are a group of rights that have been recognized by the Supreme Court as requiring a high degree of protection from government encroachment.
 
• These rights are guaranteed to all Indian citizens, and some of them are available to foreigners as well.
 
• Fundamental Rights are enforceable by the courts, subject to certain restrictions.
 
• The Constitution of India was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on **26th November 1949** and came into effect on **26th January 1950**.
 
• It lays down the framework defining fundamental political principles, establishes the structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions, and sets out fundamental rights, directive principles, and the duties of citizens.
